description: Foundation step 1 of the flatten (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §4/§9): remove vestigial infrastructure (DVC, Drizzle/Postgres) and lay down the empty target repo skeleton. No behavior change to the running app — this only deletes dead plumbing and adds structure that later tasklists move into.

userStories.title: Remove DVC entirely
userStories.description: DVC is stranded (its local-dir remote is absent) and unneeded: the GGUF was never finetuned in production and every tracked tree is regenerable. Remove it and document the one-command path to re-enable later.
acceptanceCriteria: Deleted: the four *.dvc pointers (export/culturescrape.dvc, core/out/pinakes-full.dvc, ml/data.dvc, ml/models.dvc), the .dvc/ directory, and .dvcignore.
The former DVC output paths are gitignored as regenerable build outputs.
ml/pyproject.toml no longer declares `dvc`; `uv lock` regenerated for ml with no other dependency changes in the lock diff.
`git grep -n dvc -- server core ml/src` returns only comments/docs, never live imports or invocations.
docs/ gains a short note on re-enabling DVC (or git-lfs) later via `dvc init` + a cloud remote.

userStories.title: Remove the dormant Drizzle/Postgres stack
userStories.description: Persistence is TSV + Neo4j + files ('TSV-only mode'); Drizzle/pg are declared but dormant (the db:* npm scripts are stubs). Remove them.
acceptanceCriteria: drizzle.config.ts, the pgTable schema in shared/schema.ts, and server/db.ts are removed (or stripped of all drizzle/pg references).
drizzle-orm, drizzle-zod, pg, connect-pg-simple (and express-session if it was only the pg session store) are removed from package.json.
The stub db:push / db:generate / db:migrate scripts are removed from package.json.
`bun run dev` still boots the server and the existing vitest suite still passes.

userStories.title: Create the target repo skeleton
userStories.description: Add the empty top-level structure the flatten targets, so later tasklists move into a known layout. Directories only; no code moves in this tasklist.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty directories exist, each with a README.md stating its purpose per the plan: services/api/, engine/, web/, contracts/, data/source/, build/, infra/, tooling/.
client/, core/, server/, shared/ are untouched by this tasklist.
